lines.t: his creation like a blanket and the light of his glory reaches beyond the stars of heaven
his majesty is beyond comprehension it transcends space and time
The express image of the Holy is revealed
He is known of His own
His glory shines from the east
The Shekinah of the Father's only Son
Wonderful is His name. Wonderful are His ways. He wears truth as a garment, and glory is His vesture, and love is His crowning glory.
all life proceeds from him he holds all things together by the word of his power his way
is from everlasting and with his mouth he testifies to the truth
The Father and the Son are one
Wonderful, is his name. Wonderful, are his ways. He wears truth as a garment, and glory is his vesture, and love is his crowning glory.
And love is his crowning glory.
